supersedes_execution_route_not_physics: gauge-transform-protocol.json symbolic time-evolution route failed because WSL gfortran is unavailable; preserve that log and use existing native outputs

native_grid_transformation.scaling: multiply all CAMB transfer-data variables by q^2 to undo their documented 1/k^2 output scaling
native_grid_transformation.velocity_recovery: v_b=-conformal_H*(V_Nb-V_Nc)/q from V_Nc=-q sigma/H and V_Nb=-q(v_b+sigma)/H
native_grid_transformation.independent_velocity_check: compare recovered v_b with direct v_baryon_cdm output; synchronous v_c=0
native_grid_transformation.symbolic_check: simplify(make_frame_invariant(delta_m, frame=v_m)-class_expression) must be exactly zero; no compilation

internal_acceptance.meaning: These tests check output scaling, velocity recovery and gauge algebra, not physical agreement between codes.

sparse_crosscode.selection: nearest native q for each target with nine unique indices
sparse_crosscode.class_variable: native d_m column; signed linear interpolation in ln(k), no smoothing or extrapolation
sparse_crosscode.acceptance: none; report the actual signed values and do not infer whole-spectrum convergence

output_rule: Write new gauge-transform-native artifacts and preserve all previous outputs and the failed symbolic-run log.
boundaries: No new solver run, compiler installation, physical parameter change, or nonzero CDM placeholder.
Full native-grid transformation does not itself close cross-code implementation differences or band-power convergence.
No observational likelihood, covariance, joint BBN, nonlinear calculation, or model-family exclusion.
